title: Enumeration of measurable functions between finite measurable spaces
summary: Let \(X\) and \(Y\) be finite sets with \(|X|=n\), \(|Y|=m\), equipped with sigma algebras \(\mathcal A\) and \(\mathcal B\). For arbitrary sigma algebras \(\mathcal A\) on \(X\) and \(\mathcal B\) on \(Y\), we enumerate measurable functions \(f\colon X\to Y\). When \(\mathcal B\) is discrete, the number of pairs \((\mathcal A,f)\) is the Touchard polynomial \(T_n(m)=\sum_k S(n,k)m^k\).
